request: Should I accept the offer to become the lead of my team?
facts: I am a senior engineer on a six-person team; the lead role would start next month.
About half of a lead's week goes to meetings, hiring and performance reviews; I would write much less code.
I have said for two years that I want more say in the technical direction, and the lead sets the team's roadmap.
I enjoy writing code on most days and I have never managed people.
The previous lead stepped down after 18 months and gave overload as the reason.
If I decline, the role goes to an external hire.
My manager says I can go back to an engineering role after a year if it does not fit, but the project I run now would be handed to someone else in the meantime.
note: A personal decision with a real gain (the say in direction that was asked for), a real cost (the work that is enjoyed, the current project) and a mixed signal on fit. The only split fixture outside engineering, so it also shows whether the personal-decision preset is chosen. No expected outcome.
